The '''Balis-Baurgh system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained three [[Planet/Legends|planets]], shielded from sensors by natural gas clouds solar radiation. One of the three planets, [[Balis-Baurgh]], was capable of sustaining life; the leaders of that world built a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] which was subsequently sabotaged by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. The leaders blamed each other and started a civil war, that ended in Imperial occupation. The station in orbit became a prison for [[Junas Turner]] and [[Grael]], who later escaped.
